overview.description: The BNY Mellon Global Fixed Income ETF (BGFI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund actively manages a broad portfolio of global debt securities considered to be relatively undervalued. It seeks high total return. BGFI was launched on Jul 27, 2026 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
